title: About Frist Studios
text:
Frist Studios is a one-person project & company based in the beautiful city of Prague.

I am passionate about creating videogames and participated in many game jam projects before.
I am always looking for new opportunities and challenges.
I am currently working on two projects. First being Fortress Guardian which this page is dedicated to. Second being an open-world isometric game about fishing called Sunken Hook
If you have any questions or would like to work with me, feel free to contact me.
